:::{#exm-mutual-information-self}
#### A fair coin is fully informative about itself
<!-- no-figure: the example reports a single number, with nothing to plot -->

Let $X$ be a fair coin toss.
Its [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) is $1$ [bit](#def-bit).
Given $X$ itself, there is no uncertainty left,
so $\entropyf{X \mid X} = 0$.
Hence $\mutinfof{X}{X} = 1 - 0 = 1$ bit (@thm-mutual-information-self),
the same as $\entropyf{X}$.

:::
